Technical details: metrics, methodology, run context, glossary

Methodology

Fixed-orientation ramp-line-circle task-space path; the selected speed scale streamed twice on the same hardware -- JT off then JT on -- encoders recorded and zero-phase Butterworth filtered; RMS = RMS(reference - encoder).

Joint Accuracy and TCP Accuracy are tracking-error metrics comparing the desired reference position and encoder-derived position.

Run Context

Sample time: 0.005 s · Filter cutoff: 10 Hz · Axis indices: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 · URDF: /home/reforge/Desktop/almond/reforge-interface/src/robot/urdf/axol-right-no-collision-geo.urdf · Model directory: /home/reforge/Desktop/almond/reforge-interface/src/robot/models/current/joint_tracker · Speed scales: 1.000x

Glossary

TCP (Tool Center Point)
The commanded Cartesian point on the robot tool whose x, y, and z positions are tracked in task space.
JT off
Joint Tracker off: the baseline run streamed with the uncompensated reference command.
JT on
Joint Tracker on: the Reforge controller run streamed with the Joint Tracker optimized command.
RMS (root mean square)
A single error magnitude that penalizes large deviations more strongly than a simple average.
Tracking error
The capacity of the robot to remain close to the desired reference position while responding to commands as fast as possible. This is what Joint Accuracy and TCP Accuracy measure.
Improvement factor (Nx)
JT off error divided by JT on error. 4x means the error shrank to a quarter.
